standard_prerequisites.name: Reasonable implies dense open scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: The contradiction in the inductive choice of V_n.

core_obligations: Contradiction setup: a nonempty decent X with no open scheme locus, replaced by an open subspace disjoint from the largest open scheme.
Choose a nonempty affine U -> X; the stratification sequence from the degree filtration has X_0 = X_1.

Inductively choose nonempty affine opens V_n inside U_n; if some V_{n-1} meets U_n trivially, the image X' is reasonable (fibres bounded by n-1) and contains a nonempty open scheme by the reasonable proposition, a contradiction.
The limit V_infinity is nonempty; a field point of it lies over all X_d, so U x_X Spec(k) has infinite degree, contradicting decency.
proof_roadmap: Contradiction reduction; filtration; inductive affine choice with contradiction; limit point contradiction.
difficulty_reason: A theorem-level argument: contradiction reduction, inductive construction, and a limit-point finiteness contradiction.
